attempts.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: character model sheet.

Create Borro's production TURNAROUND, exactly FOUR separate full-body neutral views in one horizontal row, left to right FRONT, THREE-QUARTER, TRUE SIDE PROFILE, BACK, with all feet on one baseline and identical body scale. Native canvas 1536 x 1024 landscape, PNG. Straight orthographic model-sheet camera at Borro's middle torso height, no dramatic perspective. Soft neutral key light from upper left. Flat light grey #E9E9EC with only minimal foot contact shadows. Show the entire shell from neck to hips, broad stooped body, full hands and feet, tunic, satchel and wraps in all views; do not crop bodies. Use the maximum uniform figure height that fits FOUR correctly broad bodies side by side without overlaps or compressing them. In front view the shield stands immediately beside anatomical LEFT with his left hand resting on its edge as approved. In three-quarter, side and rear the same shield stays grounded beside the left leg and visibly steadied by the left hand, moved outward only enough to leave shell and costume readable. In the rear view show the shield's inside and its real worn leather arm strap fastened to the door. In profile show actual depth of the humped shell, not a flat cape. Exact shoulder-flower correspondence between views is critical. There are exactly four Borros and their own shields, nothing else.

Its grey human scale silhouette is excluded: DO NOT draw it, any silhouette, scale figure, height line, ruler, diagram, label or watermark. Borro is unmasked in ordinary views and has dull amber-brown eyes with no glow. Preserve the small broad flat-topped gentle head and about seven-head-tall broad body, never a turtle or brute. Skin #6C7177/#4D5257; linen #B8A98A/#8E8166; moss #6F8F4E/#4E6A35. Satchel and seed pouch remain on his anatomical RIGHT hip (picture-left in a front view); rope ends hang toward anatomical LEFT. Forearm and ankle wraps stay as in front. Shield belongs at his anatomical LEFT. It is the SAME tall rectangular old iron gate door as image 1: dark iron #3E4247, tall narrow vertical divisions, riveted perimeter, a horizontal riveted band through the dented round boss below mid-height, TWO cylindrical old hinges on the SAME physical long edge, picture-RIGHT when looking at the OUTER shield face. From the INNER face those hinges correctly appear picture-LEFT; never mirror the object or put hinges on both edges. Shield height remains about five-sixths of Borro's height. Shell is overlapping large chipped elongated roof slates, no small polygon mosaic and no turtle scutes. Preserve its overlapping courses, shoulder overhangs, moss seams and THREE flower landmarks: a high small WHITE flower on his anatomical RIGHT near the nape/crown, a YELLOW flower lower down on his anatomical RIGHT shoulder, and a WHITE flower on his anatomical LEFT shoulder. Plants remain attached to those same physical slate seams when he turns; hide far-side flowers through correct occlusion instead of moving them. Match approved visible plates exactly; continue only unseen back plates coherently without adding extra flower clusters.

Borro: a 2.4 m gentle giant, massive and round-shouldered with a slight stoop, long thick arms reaching his knees, huge blunt-fingered hands, short thick legs and wide flat bare feet; a small head for his size (about 7 heads tall), broad and flat-topped with a heavy brow ledge, small slow amber-brown eyes under heavy lids, a broad flat nose and a wide calm mouth, no hair but a few small slate plates over the crown like roof tiles; slate-grey mottled skin; a humped shell of overlapping slate plates laid like a slate roof from his neck to his hips and capping his shoulders, with moss and tiny white and yellow wildflowers growing in the cracks; a sleeveless knee-length tunic of undyed coarse linen tied with a rope belt, a gardener's canvas satchel, cloth wraps on his forearms and ankles; a door-sized dark iron shield made from an old gate door, with rivets, two old hinges on one side and a dented boss. Gentle, slow, never a brute.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
attempts.rejection_reason: Shield only about 60% of body height; approved front about 80%. Left edge of front arm also clipped.
